title: DonutSMP Old scoreboard
description:
Do you like The DonutSMP New scoreboard? No? Then this mod Is perfect for you!
This Mod reverts the New scoreboard to the Old one
body:
![Showcase](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/9196a4ff2351c969750be71c48426c99b4b673c1.png)
# DONUTSMP OLD SCOREBOARD IS BACK!
Are you tired Or dont like The New DonutSMP Scoreboard Because It looks to "Basic" Or just Bad in general?

If you Dont, You have come to the right Place!
 
This Mod Will allow You to Revert To the Old DonutSMP Scoreboard That we Know and ALL Love!

# Core Features

- A Clean looking GUI where you can Hide/Unhide Features Such as:
> - Show Money
> - Show Shards
> - Show Kills
> - Show Deaths
> - Show KeyAll (Not Used In The new DonutSMP Update Anymore, But still there for Design Purposes)
> - Show Playtime
> - Show Team (Also Unused but still there for Design Purposes
> - And Show Footer (Eu central, Na east ETC)
> - Customizable Title Name And footer!
Example:
![GUI Example 2](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/37b038be78cbc7eabceb3d0267d675842aa4a6df.jpeg)
# Why did I do this? 
- It Has come to my attention that A Bunch Of people (including Me) Dont Like the New Scoreboard Design Because it Looks to Basic. So i decided That i want to create a Mod that Reverts that! The New DonutSMP Update Also made A bunch Of people Quit The server so Maybe this Mod will Make Some of them Come Back!
- I also Find The Old Scoreboard Way More Comfortable to use and It just looks Great Compared to the New One.
- Many Players also Started the Server when the Old Scoreboard Was Still There.

# DEPENDENCIES & SETUP!
1. Make SURE that you Have [Fabric API 1.21.4](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api) Installed!
2. Make SURE that you Have [Cloth Config API](https://modrinth.com/mod/cloth-config) Installed!
3. Make SURE that you Have These Settings On in /Settings
- Show Scoreboard
- Show Money
- Show Shards
- Show Kills
- Show Deaths
- Show Playtime

### KEYBINDS:
- To Enable The old scoreboard Use The Default Keybind O (customizable in Settings)
- To Open The Config GUI Use The default Keybind P (customizable in Settings)
